src=open('test_plan.py').read()
idx=src.index("random.seed(11)")
head, tail = src[:idx], src[idx:]
tail = "def main():\n    " + tail.replace("\n","\n    ") + "\n\nif __name__=='__main__':\n    main()\n"

cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from test_plan import gen_case, peaks_of_brute
from tplan import Brute
from tlib import run
prof, fab = gen_case(545)
print(json.dumps(prof))
print(json.dumps(fab))
[plan]=run([{"op":"plan","profile":prof,"fabric":fab}])
print('plan guard', plan['guard_ns'], 'peaks', plan['peaks_as'])
b=Brute(prof,fab)
print('P',b.P,'N',b.N,'guards',b.guards,'reconfig',b.r, 'T',b.T,'S',b.S,'O',b.O)
for g in b.guards:
    env=b.envelope(g)
    print('guard',g)
    for k,v in sorted(env.items()):
        print('   ',k,v,'drift',b.drift[k[0]][k[1]]*b.T)
    print('   brute peaks', peaks_of_brute(b,g))
EOF
